ideas.idea: Render catalogue contents (mug names from /api/mugs) on the server or at build time
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx fetches in useEffect, so mug names are absent from initial HTML.

ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page (/catalogue/:id) with description, price and photo
ideas.why:
Catalogue only renders bare names in

tags, so there's nothing detailed for people or machines to read.

ideas.idea: Back up the 'shipped worldwide' claim with where, how long and cost
ideas.why: Home.jsx makes the claim with no supporting detail, and concrete shipping facts help users and machines.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD for the Bristol business
ideas.why: There is no structured data, and Home.jsx states location and craft that could be machine-readable.

ideas.idea: Add viewport meta and Open Graph tags (og:title, og:image)
ideas.why: index.html has only charset and title, so there's no viewport or social metadata.

ideas.idea: Include <lastmod> dates in the sitemap once created
ideas.why: It's accurate but has small effect and applies to any sitemap.

ideas.idea: Link from the home page body into the catalogue
ideas.why: Home.jsx has no link to the catalogue, though the nav has a link-less button.

ideas.idea: Make the catalogue h1 more descriptive (e.g. 'Handmade ceramic mugs, catalogue')
ideas.why: The h1 'Catalogue' is vague, but the change has little effect.

ideas.idea: Use a head helper like react-helmet for per-page titles
ideas.why: Both routes share one static title in index.html, so per-route titles need a head manager.
